component.name: Twain
component.summary: A GTK4 diff viewer for git repositories

description.p: Twain is a diff viewer for git repositories. Like meld, but it shows every changed file in one scrolling sequence instead of one tab per file: side-by-side diffs with curved links between changed chunks, intra-line highlights, syntax highlighting and real line numbers.
Only changed regions are shown with a few lines of context. A file tree sidebar jumps to any file, search covers the whole diff, and selected lines can carry review comments.

screenshot.caption: Every changed file side by side in one scrolling view
